summary.value: New York Marriott Downtown, at 85 West Street at Albany Street, New York, New York, USA, 10006, is a dependable Financial District base where guests rave about river views, cleanliness and a safe neighborhood near the ferries. Getting uptown is easy, but some rooms and beds are small, so pick the room type carefully.

description.value: The hotel sits at 85 West Street at Albany Street, New York, New York, USA, 10006, close to the Statue of Liberty ferries. Its dining story is the New York Marriott Downtown – home to Bill’s Bar & Burger, renowned for serving some of the best burgers in the country, plus a bar with live music, inventive cocktails and a selection of regional beers. Trip.com shows 8.6 / 10 Very good 342 reviews; guests write Safe and good location. Loved the great river view and is very clean. The main caveat: The room was tiny, and the bed was also very small in some categories.

review1: Guests describe the Marriott Downtown's Financial District setting as safe and convenient, with river views and very clean rooms as frequent highlights.
review2: Rooms facing the water are repeatedly praised for the views, and cleanliness is a constant across the review set for this property.
review3: Getting around from downtown is easy, with guests mentioning that hop-on sightseeing buses and transit link the hotel to the rest of the city.
review4: Room size divides opinion, with some guests finding rooms and beds small, so it is worth checking the room category carefully before booking.
